param: π Initial susceptibility (proportion susceptible at start of season); prior U(0,1)
λ₀ Initial infection rate (force of infection at epidemic start); prior U(0,0.000241)
ψ Exponential growth rate (EGR) at epidemic start; prior U(0,0.39)
η Negative Binomial over-dispersion parameter for weekly ICU/HDU counts; prior U(1,100)
pICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection; prior U(0,1)
σ Daily rate of transition E1→E2 and E2→I1 (two-stage latent period)
γ Daily rate of transition I1→I2 and I2→R (two-stage infectious period)
μICU|E Mean time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (waiting time distribution)
σ²ICU|E Variance of time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (waiting time distribution)
β Transmission rate in λ(t)=β·I(t)/N; in the paper inferred via EGR re-parameterization (SI 1.1)
δt Model time step (quarter of a day)
